title: MarkersRequest
description: The 'request' part of a 'markers' job (runner protocol 1.2; part 'photo', one image): MarkerDetectionOptions. Absent options keep the detector's defaults.

allowedIds.description: The ids that may appear (default 0..35); any other decoded id is a false positive.

minSidePx.description: Candidates with a smaller mean side are rejected (20).

maxEdgeRatio.description: Longest / shortest edge above this is rejected (4).

refineCorners.description: Re-fit corners as intersections of the square's edge lines (true).

minQuietZoneContrast.description: Lowest quiet-zone contrast (-0.5; 0.1 for plan-printed markers).

brightenedPass.description: Also decode on a brightened copy (false).
